state_definition.1_null: baggage is null on every flight of the month
state_definition.2_all_zero: excess and free baggage are zero on every flight: not reported, or indistinguishable from it
state_definition.3_free_only: free baggage is reported, but excess is zero on every flight
state_definition.4_excess_under_1pct: excess is above zero on under 1% of flights
state_definition.5_excess_reported: excess is above zero on at least 1% of flights
